sections.title: CloudBase Production Refactor Requirements
P0 Architecture
Production uses CloudBase Run API, CloudBase PostgreSQL REST/RPC, private CloudBase Storage and an on-demand Cloud Function Worker.
Production must not start embedded PostgreSQL, a resident media Worker or persistent local media storage.
The pre-refactor implementation must remain recoverable from a dedicated local and remote branch.
P0 Database and points
New registration grants 10 account points exactly once.
Successful exact-speech or chat generation consumes exactly one point; failures and blocks consume zero.
Transactional operations use PostgreSQL RPC and roll back atomically.
The 楼9.9/50-point product is server-configurable and order creation is idempotent.
P0 WeChat Pay
JSAPI order creation and `wx.requestPayment` parameters retain merchant RSA signing.
The callback uses the raw request body, WeChat Pay public-key/platform-certificate verification and APIv3 AES-GCM decryption.
Callback and active order refresh converge on one payment RPC.
Duplicate/concurrent payment success grants 50 points and one ledger exactly once.
P0 Media and voice
Up to 100MB authorized video uploads directly to private storage with a signed URL and never traverses the Run request body.
Worker downloads source video to temporary storage, runs FFmpeg, enrolls Aliyun CosyVoice and uploads reference/preview/generated audio.
Private playback requires server authorization and a short-lived signed download URL.
Provider voice identifiers are encrypted at rest.
P0 Job and deletion lifecycle
API requests return without waiting for FFmpeg or model work.
Durable jobs use leases, heartbeat, retry and duplicate-claim protection.
Voice/account deletion removes the Aliyun provider voice and private storage objects before final database cleanup.
API or function restart must not lose point, payment or job state.
P1 Product surfaces
Existing mini-program login, creation, authorization, preview, workbench, purchase, voices, account, settings and legal pages retain their API contracts.
SELF, OTHER and MINOR authorization types remain supported.
Invitation rewards and a visual operations admin remain deferred.
Acceptance evidence
External launch gates
